answer: No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 55 identities per epoch. Audits are recorded in glacier, queued in kernel, and vertex publishes the wait time. A farm of 194 fresh keys as a result waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 4018 identities would post 1139 proofs and burn roughly 62 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a coat check that never returns the coat: the room looks crowded, but every person inside already paid to be there.
